description: Roll out a new Group Policy Object (GPO) to 2000 Windows endpoints across an enterprise domain using staged deployment rings. The GPO configures a security baseline (account lockout policy, SMB signing, Windows Firewall rules). Deployment must follow staged rings: a canary OU of 50 endpoints (ring 0), then 250 endpoints (ring 1), then 1000 endpoints (ring 2), then the full fleet (ring 3). Each ring must include a conflict/deny filter check (detect GPOs that override or conflict with existing policies) and a health verification step (gpresult, event log scan for policy apply errors) before advancing to the next ring. A rollback plan (disable or delete the GPO, force gpupdate /force on affected OUs) must exist. Risk factors: GPO conflicts can break authentication or network access on affected hosts, group-policy propagation latency can mask failures, and some settings require a reboot to take effect. Tools available: Group Policy Management Console (GPMC), PowerShell GroupPolicy module, gpresult, gpupdate, Active Directory Users and Computers.
